intro: Gloom Weed is a sickly plant native to the blighted soil of Tirisfal Glades, commonly growing in the fields between Deathknell and Brill. It is best known as the wrong plant collected by Gordo, a lumbering Forsaken abomination who confuses it with the alchemy reagent doom weed.

p: Sprouting amid the gloom and decay of Tirisfal Glades, Gloom Weed thrives in the fallow earth west of Brill and east of the Solliden Farmstead. Despite its morbid name, the plant is relatively harmless and lacks the potent alchemical kick prized by the Royal Apothecary Society. Its primary notoriety stems from the abomination Gordo, who wanders the roadway attempting to pull weeds with his massive, clumsy hands. Having misunderstood his master's commands, Gordo constantly gathers Gloom Weed and enlists gullible travelers to carry bunches of it back to Master Holland in the Brill graveyard, much to the apothecary's supreme annoyance.
